description: Agent Roles: submit a role changing holders: the handoff with its id, the role, the prior holder, the incoming holder and when it changed hands; the description with its version before and after, when it was rewritten and by whom, what the rewrite changed and the handoff note as written, read for wording such as as is, unchanged or same as before; the prior holder’s permissions for the role, each with whether it was revoked, and when they were revoked; the incoming holder’s acceptance with whether it was given, when and where it is recorded (the role record, a ticket, a message or nowhere); and the open work with whether it was listed at the handoff and each item with who now holds it. The signed report gives the handoff, the description with whether it was carried over and the wording found, the revocation item by item, the acceptance and the open work, and counts them, and names an inherited role: a description carried over at the same version or passed on unchanged with no rewrite, a prior holder who keeps any of the role’s permissions, an acceptance not given or not recorded and open work never listed; then a rewrite or revocation after the handoff date, an acceptance recorded only in a message, open items with no holder and a rewrite with no record of what changed, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An unstated rewrite, revocation, acceptance or open-work list leaves the handoff unverified. This reads one role passing from holder to holder against the rewrite rule: a task passed between agents is the Agent Handoffs checks such as wever_handoff-acceptance-check, a takeover package for a receiver is wever_handover-check and one half-finished job’s state is wever_job-handoff-pack. Verdict role_handoff_inherited, role_handoff_partial, role_handoff_unverified or role_handoff_rewritten. POST /api/role-handoff-check. Reads the role records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Roles reads a role’s own records and checks the role itself: what the job is, who owns it, whether the permissions the agent holds match the written role, where its scope ends, whether a change of holder rewrote the description, whether it is reviewed on schedule, whether duties stay apart across the roles one agent holds, and whether delegations stay inside what the role allows. Beside it, wever_onboarding-permissions-check and wever_onboarding-readiness-check read a new agent’s grants and written job at joining, while a role check reads the written role and its records at any time after; wever_authority-scope-check reads one action’s access against its authority grant, while the permission match check reads every permission held against the role; and the Agent Delegation checks such as wever_delegation-scope-check read one delegation on its own terms, while the delegation check reads every delegation against what the role allows. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-roles-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-roles/.
